messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Alert: Production p99 latency spike detected on shared-gpu-pool-3 at 2026-03-15T21:26:39Z. p95=420ms, p99=2.3s for streaming calls. SLO: p99 < 1s.

pagerbot: Paging oncall (primary: alex) — severity: Sev2. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/generate. Approx 12% of requests failing streaming stall retries.

alex: on it. grabbing dashboards now. any customer-facing pages?

mina: seeing elevated io.wait on the hosts in pool-3, plus kernel per-cgroup writeback spikes. I/O bandwidth looks saturated on host-3 and host-7.

sam: can you paste the psi stats? also any recent deploys to that pool?

mina: sure — ssh to host-7 and ran:
```
$ cat /proc/pressure/io
some 52855 52432 0.80
full 0 0 0.00
```
and cgroup stats:
```
cg1: writeback_bytes=1.9GB, active_tasks=54
cg2: writeback_bytes=8.2GB, active_tasks=210  <-- noisy-tenant
```

luis: noisy tenant looks like tenant-42 (ml-eval-runner) — heavy checkpoints. That tenant's jobs started ~21:10 UTC.

alex: confirmed. p95 for tenant-42 requests spikes to 1.4s, p99 > 3s. It looks like tenant-42 is causing IO saturation that cascades into streaming stalls.

sam: mitigation options: 1) throttle tenant-42 cgroup blkio, 2) move tenant-42 off to an isolated host, 3) evict non-critical jobs from that tenant. Which do we run now?

mina: we can apply temporary blkio throttle quickly. command below (+ rollback):
```sh
# limit tenant-42 to 50MB/s reads/writes
cgset -r blkio.throttle.read_bps_device=8:0:52428800 tenant-42
cgset -r blkio.throttle.write_bps_device=8:0:52428800 tenant-42
```

alex: run that now. sam execute? I'll monitor SLOs and streaming traces.

sam: running throttle on host-7 and host-3 for tenant-42...

sam: throttle applied on host-3 & host-7.

mina: immediate improvement: host IO utilization down 30%. p95 for pool decreased to ~330ms within 45s. p99 trending down but still 1.1-1.4s.

luis: noted. customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported transient degraded streaming sessions; all error rates back to baseline within 3m after throttle. No long-term failures detected.

alex: good short-term mitigation. We need medium-term: either migrate tenant-42 to dedicated (reserved) machines or schedule eval runs during off-peak windows.

incident-bot: ACTIONS created: INC-6318009999 — apply throttle (done), monitor 60m, plan migration. Assigned: alex (owner).

sam: follow-ups: collect top syscall traces for tenant-42 to see if IO pattern can be reduced. Also create eviction playbook to fast-evict noisy tenants without manual ssh.

mina: extracted iostat snapshot:
```
Device    r/s   w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm  %util
sda      12.3 120.5  512.4 7340.1   62.5    21.3   8.5   0.9   92.4
```
indicates sustained writes.

luis: notified support that affected customers saw short stalls. CS will follow up if any customer wants postmortem.

alex: handoff: I'll stay for the next 45m to verify p99 < 1s. If it holds, we'll mark resolved and schedule migration JIRA. If it doesn't, escalate to pool autoscale (spin up two extra hosts) and consider live-migration.

sam: created quick runbook entry in ops/tmp: "noisy-tenant-throttle" with command snippets and rollbacks.

mina: note: we should add alert rule for cgroup writeback rate > 5GB in 10m (this would preempt noisy checkpointing jobs).

alex: agreed. @luis please add to infra backlog and tag as P1 for Dedicated-migration discussion.

luis: will do. adding JIRA INFRA-2291.

incident-bot: STATUS update: mitigation applied, partial reduction in latency, monitoring.

sam: post-mortem notes to collect: timestamps of throttle, hosts affected, top processes in tenant-42, customer impact windows, and any deploys correlated.

alex: quick risk note — blkio throttle can increase job duration for tenant-42; ensure we communicate to tenant owner. luis please coordinate.

luis: cc @tenant-42-owner (via email) + created internal ticket to coordinate schedule.

mina: p99 now stable at ~0.9s across pool-3 for last 10m. p95 ~280ms. streaming stalls count dropped to baseline.

alex: marking incident as mitigated, not resolved. I'll do a handoff to the next oncall at 2026-03-15T22:15Z. Next oncall: sam.

sam: confirmed handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then file final notes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-6318009999 — mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to Sev3.

alex: final ask — create long-term plan: (A) tenant isolation enforcement + quotas, (B) autoscale thresholds for pools based on per-cgroup writeback, (C) add synthetic streaming trace that runs during low-traffic windows to validate no tail regressions after any kernel/driver updates.

luis: will coordinate infra + product to scope.

sam: adding retrospective notes to the incident thread and linking graphs. Good job team. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Closing note: if p99 rises again, automatic fallback to dedicated-variant is available via routing policy (manual for now). Recommend adding an automated fallback runbook.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll open a short postmortem doc and ping for a blameless review tomorrow.
